name: Kaioken Local HTTP Load Testing
free_limit: Free local Rust CLI for HTTP load testing with real-time terminal metrics, configurable arrival rates, latency thresholds, request checks, regression comparison and JSON/CSV/HTML reports; no software usage quota or expiration.
watch_out: Runs on user-provided machines or CI runners; target infrastructure, network traffic and CI resources may incur costs. Does not include a managed load-testing service. Optional integrations require separate setup.
